name: Hero — Split Gallery
description: Two-column hero. Left: eyebrow, display headline, supporting copy, single CTA. Right: a dual-column vertical-marquee gallery of images that scroll in opposite directions inside a faded frame.

headline.default: We bridge the gap between concept and creation.

supporting.default: Helping you unlock business potential with strategic consulting every step of the way.

responsive.notes: At 48rem+ the gallery sits to the right of the text as a dual-column vertical marquee. Below 48rem the layout stacks: copy on top, a single full-width horizontal marquee underneath. Marquee wrap distance is pixel-measured per breakpoint so the loop is seamless across any gap or aspect ratio.

changelog.summary: Mobile / tablet now render a single horizontal marquee under the copy instead of a cramped half-width vertical strip. Marquee loop converted to pixel-measured wrap (seamless at any gap / aspect ratio).
